kind.description: All CLC-D vectors are containment vectors: parent vs child grant.

ext_revision.description: CLC revision the containment vector declares (CLC-D is folded into the language revision stream, §13.11; the field name is retained from the retired EXT-00 draft). A runner whose declared revision is outside its compatible range MUST NOT short-circuit (the language revision gate CLC-A §12.1 applies to CLC-A inputs; CLC-D is declared per-implementation, §13).

parent.description: Parent grant GP under test: the boundary grant (principal's authorization).

child.description: Child grant GC under test: the delegate's requested capability.

reason.description: Expected resolved reason code on a false result (child_exceeds_parent / params_not_narrower / a CLC-A syntax code / different_namespace). Constraint differences never produce a reason: constraints are not part of the relation. null or omitted = not asserted; true results carry no reason.
